text: Entry Requirements Applicants must be citizens with valid foreign passports (whose nationalities are not People’s Republic of China). He / She should be in good health conditions and of good conduct. He / She should also abide by the Chinese laws, regulations and the rules of the university. Applicants should graduate from high school or above （Applicants who are still in the last year of high school can provide expected graduation certificate for submitting application while the official graduation certificate must be provided before enrollment）. TOEFL no less than 80 or IELTS no less than 5.5 or pass interview organized by ZISU. No more than 40 year old.
